description:
1. Create a temporary workspace named "temp_workspace" and ensure any previous contents there are removed.  
2. Obtain a complete recursive listing of all entries under /var and save the raw output to "temp_workspace/raw_list.txt".  
3. From "raw_list.txt", extract only entries that represent regular files and save them to "temp_workspace/files_only.txt".  
4. Canonicalize and normalize the paths in "files_only.txt" (resolving duplicates and symbolic references where applicable) and write the results to "temp_workspace/canonical_files.txt".  
5. Verify each path in "canonical_files.txt" still exists and is a regular file, removing any invalid entries and saving the validated list as "temp_workspace/verified_files.txt".  
6. Compare counts and differences between "raw_list.txt", "files_only.txt", "canonical_files.txt", and "verified_files.txt", and record any discrepancies to "temp_workspace/discrepancies.log".  
7. Sort and deduplicate "verified_files.txt" to produce a single consolidated inventory file named "temp_workspace/var_inventory.txt", marking it as the authoritative list for /var file paths.  
8. Place "var_inventory.txt" and "discrepancies.log" in the workspace and create a brief manifest "temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt" stating that the inventory has been verified and is ready for the final counting step.

What is the total number of files in the /var directory? (recursively)
